title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
why: The book I keep going back to for storage, replication, partitioning, and what actually fails when data grows. Second edition.

title: Clean Architecture
author: Robert C. Martin
why: Boundaries, dependency direction, and how to keep a codebase from rotting as features pile up.

why: Principles, practices, and patterns for multi-tenant systems on AWS — isolation, tenancy models, the stuff that bites you in production.

why: How to attack software complexity from the domain, not from the framework of the week.

title: Building Microservices
author: Sam Newman
why: Second edition. When to split, when not to, and what you actually pay for independently deployable services.

title: Designing Distributed Systems
author: Brendan Burns
why: Patterns you keep rediscovering in containers and orchestrators — written by someone who built Kubernetes.
